notes.title: Thanks and a few notes!
notes.content:
Hey all, thanks for buying Piloteer! Hope you're liking it so far (and not throwing your computer out of your window.)

Couple things:
- The "Baby's First Landing" achievement wasn't set up correctly, so no one was able to get it. Now the very next time you land on your feet, you should get the achievement.
- Please let me know if you run into any other major issues or bugs and I'll try to get them sorted out ASAP.
- Feel free to do let's plays of the game! Monetize all you want.
- Post some of your craziest crashes on the community page! I'd love to see them (and I'm sure others would too.)

Thanks everyone for your support so far!
